italy_estranged.ambiguity: The ontology gives no threshold for false (Italy reconciled with the West), which the delegated reviewer of the Claude replay listed as an ambiguous rule; the hindsight reading keeps the estrangement from Ethiopia (3 Oct 1935) through the window. The two independent blind replay readers read it false: Claude from 1938Q2 on the Anglo-Italian Agreement signed 16 Apr 1938 (frus1938v01/d90, d23, d145, d146), DeepSeek from 1938Q1/1938Q2 (frus1938v01/d413 of 17 Feb 1938, d146 of 9 May 1938, frus1938v02/d575 of 16 Nov 1938). The review sample rejects the 1938Q2 readings (the agreement signed but not in force, the Ethiopian conquest unrecognised: proposals 1938Q2-013, -021, -039, -041) and accepts the 1938Q4 ones (France's decision to recognise the Italian Empire, frus1938v01/d205, 5 Oct 1938, proposal 1938Q4-007; the agreement put into force with Britain's recognition, frus1938v02/d575, 16 Nov 1938, proposal 1938Q4-039). The window closes with 1939Q1: the Pact of Steel (22 May 1939) makes 1939Q2 concrete true again. Accepted as proposed (owner's decision 7j; candidate 1 of docs/ambiguous_levels.md section 8). Sources: reports/replay_ww2_frus_claude/README.md; reports/replay_ww2_frus_claude/metrics_claude.md; reports/replay_ww2_frus_claude/review_sample.csv; reports/replay_ww2_frus_deepseek/README.md; reports/replay_ww2_frus_deepseek/metrics_deepseek.md.

rearm_delay_ticks.basis: Provisional: the action catalogue's one-year lag from a rearmament decision to fielded force (docs/actions_ww2.md, rearm). NMC shows German military personnel rising from 461 to 596 thousand (1935 to 1936) in the year after conscription was reintroduced in March 1935, and British milex rising by 40 to 50 percent a year from 1936 to 1938 before the 1939 jump. To be refined by the historian from the programme records (Tooze 2006 for Germany; the Defence Requirements reports for Britain).
